title: Quote of the day by Myron Scholes: "At times of shock, converting illiquid assets to cash to build flexibility is very expensive. Finding an umbrella in a rain storm might be impossible or very costly."
description: Nobel laureate Myron Scholes emphasizes liquidity's value during market shocks.  Illiquid assets become difficult to sell without significant price reductions.  Finding cash during a crisis is often impossible or extremely costly.  Investors should maintain adequate liquidity and diversify their portfolios.  This preparation ensures flexibility and avoids forced sales during volatility.
